summary: The accepted v8 release policy downgrades a missed temporary-stage fmax target to a warning when finite-force and geometry guards pass, records physical/restraint/projected NEB forces, and leaves final unrestrained gates unchanged; no job was submitted.

payload.objective: Await separate explicit authorization before any MZ73 preflight or execution of the reviewed v8 warning-release package.
current_evidence: The legacy strict release-stage mode remains available, while v8 explicitly selects nonconverged_stage_action=warning_continue.
Every release stage records recent fmax history and separates MatRIS physical, temporary-restraint, and projected NEB force maxima.
A missed temporary-stage fmax target cannot by itself stop v8 when forces are finite and all per-step geometry guards pass.
All temporary restraints must still be removed before ordinary ML-NEB; the final unrestrained geometry and 0.10 eV/A ordinary ML-NEB target remain unchanged.
The 19 structures are hash-identical to v7, and no remote preflight, upload, GPU execution, VASP/VTST, Dimer, TS, or barrier action occurred.
payload.one_executable_step: Only after explicit authorization, run a hash-bound MZ73 preflight for request SHA-256 52e2e9fffb100452a675fa0f1c42af0aee06c2785269a06b978bf45e701c9fed; do not submit a GPU job in the same step unless separately authorized.
payload.submission_boundary: Preparing and testing v8 does not authorize remote preflight, upload, GPU resubmission, fine-tuning, VASP/VTST, Dimer, or TS/barrier claims.
done_when: The user explicitly decides whether to authorize the v8 MZ73 preflight or execution.
Any later execution remains bound to the reviewed request and executor hashes.
